newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merrill Lynch keeps Nokia buy after Q1.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch keeps Nokia buy after Q1.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said in a research note dated April 30 and received on Monday it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy, which had reported "very strong" first-quarter earnings.
"Broadly there were no surprises from Q1 and this was a very strong set of results," Merrill Lynch said.
"Revenues in both the handsets and infrastructure grew faster than anticipated ... Margins saw a distinct improvement," it said.
"We are maintaining our buy recommendation for both the intermediate and the longer term," Merrill Lynch said.
The investment bank said it had raised its full-year 1997 earnings per share forecast to 15.5 markka from 15.0 markka. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, news@reuters.fi
